caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent pitcher rendered in shades of blue, positioned centrally against a beige background. The pitcher features a rounded body that narrows at the neck, flares outward at the rim, and has an elongated, curved handle attached to the right side with a decorative loop near the base of the handle. The outline of the pitcher is defined by darker blue and black lines, with lighter blue and grayish-blue tones suggesting the glass material’s transparency and reflections. The pitcher sits in the middle of a rectangular border, and there is no other object or detailing within the drawing area apart from the artist's signature, "John Tarantino," in small text at the lower right corner.
title: Pitcher
